fields.Address: 1320 Celebrity Cir #191, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Charles Bach Wonders Theatre
fields.Short Description: An intimate magic and comedy theater of about 200 seats.

fields.Address: 4002 Deville St, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Grand 14 Cinemas at Market Common
fields.Short Description: Grand 14 Cinema is a 14-screen movie theater at 4002 Deville St. in The Market Common, with more than 2,600 leather stadium rocker seats and digital Dolby and DTS sound. Concessions are sold, and the theater runs a Sensory-Friendly Series with adjusted lights and sound, Flashback Cinema classic films and a Discount Tuesday after 6 p.m.

fields.Address: 1195 Celebrity Cir, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Broadway Theatre: Le Grand Cirque Adrenaline
fields.Short Description: An acrobatic spectacle at Broadway at the Beach, about two hours with intermission.

fields.Address: 701 Main St, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: Greg Rowles Legacy Theatre
fields.Short Description: A local favorite for music, comedy and storytelling. The North Myrtle Beach theater bills itself as 100% live music, with concerts and shows through the year, a Broadway series and a Christmas show. Check the theater's calendar for the current lineup.

fields.Address: 6803 N Ocean Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
fields.Name: Polynesian Fire Luau
fields.Short Description: Hula, fire dancing, live music and an island buffet.

fields.Price: Murder mystery dinner from $59.99; Queens of Country from $20
fields.Address: 10429 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
fields.Name: Murder in the Wild West
fields.Short Description: A Wild West-themed murder mystery dinner show where guests witness a crime and help solve it. The show runs about two hours and is open to all ages, and an optional package lets one member of your party kick off the show. The menu is listed on the website.

fields.Address: 2850 Robert M Grissom Pkwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Topgolf Myrtle Beach
fields.Short Description: Climate-controlled hitting bays with targets, food and drinks. Open daily, late on weekends.

fields.Hours Note: Box office hours. Show times vary; see the show calendar.
fields.Address: 4750 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: Alabama Theatre
fields.Short Description: Open since 1993 at Barefoot Landing. Home of the ICONIC variety show, which combines music, dance and comedy and runs February through October, with The South's Grandest Christmas Show in November and December. On nights the cast is off, guest artists perform country, Motown, pop and comedy.

fields.Address: 1251 21st Ave N, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Myrtle Beach Pelicans
fields.Short Description: The Myrtle Beach Pelicans are a Single-A affiliate in the Carolina League, playing at Pelicans Ballpark, which opened in 1999 with its first game on April 12 of that year. The seating bowl uses seats from Fulton County Stadium, the former home of the Atlanta Braves. The park holds 4,800 fixed seats, or up to 6,599 with standing room, and Stadium Journey ranked it the league's top ballpark from 2011 to 2015.

fields.Address: 1329 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Riga Tony's Murder Mystery Dinner
fields.Short Description: An interactive comedy murder mystery with an Italian dinner.

fields.Address: 335 Main St, Conway, SC 29526
fields.Name: Theatre of the Republic
fields.Short Description: Theatre of the Republic is a nonprofit community theater in downtown Conway, founded in 1969. It stages a season of plays and musicals on Main Street, with a schedule that runs through November 2027, and is a good evening out for anyone staying in the Conway area or driving in from the beach.

fields.Address: 2925 Hollywood Dr, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Legends in Concert
fields.Short Description: Legends in Concert is a live tribute show at the Legends in Concert Theater at Broadway at the Beach, 2925 Hollywood Dr. It began in 1983 as a limited engagement in Las Vegas and bills itself as the original and longest-running live tribute concert. Performers sing live with a live band and dancers, with no lip-syncing, and lineups change four times a year. The show runs about two hours with a 15-minute intermission, is family-friendly, and the theater is wheelchair accessible. It is not a dinner theater, but snacks, drinks, beer and wine are sold.

fields.Address: 10177 N Kings Hwy, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
fields.Name: AMC Classic Myrtle Beach 12
fields.Short Description: A 12-screen first-run theater near Barefoot Landing with recliners and reserved seating. Crowds tend to be smaller than at the bigger venues.

fields.Address: 1220 Port Dr, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: GTS Theatre
fields.Short Description: An intimate theater with Motown, Rock N' Soul, Elvis and Kenny Rogers tribute shows.

fields.Hours Note: Concert times vary; see the show calendar on the House of Blues site.
fields.Address: 4640 Highway 17 South, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: House of Blues Myrtle Beach
fields.Short Description: A live music venue and restaurant on Highway 17 South with three spaces: the Music Hall for concerts and tribute acts, the Indigo Room, and a restaurant and bar serving Southern-inspired food. Shows span rock, metal, R&B and tribute nights, and a Gospel Brunch and private events round out the calendar.

fields.Hours Note: Christmas show runs from November 4. Every ticket includes a four-course feast; kids 2 and under free on a lap.
fields.Address: 8907 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
fields.Name: Pirates Voyage
fields.Short Description: Pirate ship battles, acrobatics, sea lions and a four-course dinner. Guests cheer for the Crimson or Sapphire crew as a pirate battle with mermaids unfolds, with horse-riding stunts, music and special effects along the way. It is built for families, with child tickets for kids up to age 9.

fields.Hours Note: Show times vary by date; see the calendar. About two hours, with a four-course dinner.
fields.Price: Adults $76.95, kids $47.95 (dinner and two rounds of soft drinks included)
fields.Address: 2904 Fantasy Way, Myrtle Beach, SC 29579
fields.Name: Medieval Times
fields.Short Description: A jousting tournament with horses, a falcon and a feast eaten by hand. The two-hour show features six knights in jousts and sword fights alongside Pure Spanish horses and a royal falcon, with a four-course meal served during the performance. Preferred and priority seating are available as upgrades.

fields.Address: 220 Rivertown Blvd, Conway, SC 29526
fields.Name: B&B Theatres Conway 12
fields.Short Description: B&B Theatres Conway 12 is a twelve-screen movie theater at Rivertown in Conway with recliner seating and party rooms. It is an easy rainy-day option for families and groups staying inland.

fields.Hours Note: The Christmas Special is playing now, most days at 7 PM with some 1 PM matinees.
fields.Address: 8901 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29572
fields.Name: Carolina Opry
fields.Short Description: Music, dance and comedy, including Time Warp and a long-running Christmas show. The theater is in its 38th season and also hosts a performing arts concert series with guest acts. Check the calendar for the current lineup.

fields.Hours Note: Showtimes change daily; check Cinemark's site.
fields.Address: 2100 Coastal Grand Circle, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Cinemark Myrtle Beach
fields.Short Description: The latest movies in recliner loungers, with popcorn and drinks for the grown-ups. A good rainy-day escape at Coastal Grand Mall; check the theater's page before you go to see which premium formats it offers.

fields.Address: 710 Front St, Georgetown, SC 29440
fields.Name: Strand Theater
fields.Short Description: Home of the Swamp Fox Players, a live community theater company, in historic downtown Georgetown on Front Street across from the Harborwalk. Locally staged productions include classic stage adaptations, and a Juniors program gives young performers a place to take the stage.

fields.Address: 3237 Waccamaw Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29579
fields.Name: The Asher Theatre
fields.Short Description: Family-friendly magic, comedy and impressions.
